answer: Each agent identity requires a bonded entry: to register on an island shard, an agent burns 100 tokens into a summit escrow contract that checkpoints identity-merkle-roots across shards via a bridge. A sybil attacker must burn fresh stake for every fake identity, and any bridge attestation traced to a fraudulent root triggers automatic slashing of that stake—so mass fake identities become linearly expensive and recoverable fraud is zero.
